question: This video explains how the game Slotbound sold 100,000 copies in 3 days on Steam. Paraphrase everything; quote nothing longer than 6 words. 1) Video length and a one-line summary. 2) Every reason the video gives for the sales, as an ordered list, each with its timestamp and the exact numbers, dates and examples given (wishlists, demo dates, demo players, events or festivals, price, discount, languages, countries, revenue, reviews, concurrent players). 3) The marketing timeline in date order: what was done first, where (which sites, platforms, communities, creators or streamers), and what each step produced. 4) Why the game idea itself spread: the hook, the genre, which earlier hit games it borrows from, and what makes it easy to show in a short clip. 5) How the game was made: which AI tools for code, art and sound, the engine, how long, the maker's background, team size and cost, if stated. 6) How buyers and Steam reacted to the AI use, any AI disclosure, and how the maker handled it. 7) What is said about the game being cloned and whether that helped or hurt. 8) What the maker did after launch (patches, replies to reviews). 9) The lessons or steps the video tells other makers to copy, in order. 10) For each claim in 2 to 9, say whether the video shows evidence on screen (a chart, a post, a store page) or only asserts it, and name any source shown.
